title: Better Lichen
description: Some better colours for Minecraft glow lichen so that you never confuse them with diamonds again!
body:
Hello, this is a resource pack I made to enhance your Minecraft experience by making glow lichen look better and less confusing!
## What it does
This mod adds **8 glow lichen texture variants** for use in your world!

It is **very** vanilla friendly, so it fits in perfectly with other mods and resource packs!

Textures are determined randomly based on position in the world by Minecraft itself.

None of the colours are similar to diamond ore, so that no one becomes confused.
## Possible new features
- Continuity between lichen in the same group
- New variants for sculk or vines

Hope you like it!
